start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:admit-an-audience-question-to-private-drafts with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and observed [{\"question\": \"How much is it?\"}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the questions, reviews and private work are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:admit-an-audience-question-to-private-drafts" with store, and the questions observed, reviews and admissions to keep.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts: every attempt must give the outcome the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps what it was given; a question admitted without an accepted review is refused with the store's own words, and an answer stays a private draft until a person reviews it.

worked_examples.title: A question an audience asked is kept, reviewed and admitted to private work
worked_examples.ask: Keep this question from the public page and admit it, since I accept it with its answer and rights words.

store.where: postgresql database example_shop on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The look step found the questions kept in the tables audience_question, audience_question_review and audience_answer_work, made by an earlier run.
worked_examples.hands_back: kept_ids ["how much is it?"], refused [] and found_ids ["how much is it?"]; the work reads pending_draft, and asking again returns work_already_exists.
